title: De Gratia Dei Et Libero Voluntatis Arbitrio
author: Prosperus Aquitanus
source: Translated by Claude from stoa0237.stoa002.opp-lat1, as held by Open Greek and Latin's Patrologia Latina.
statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

passages.original: Domino b fratri dilectissimo in Christo, et merito venerabili RUFINO, PROSPER æternam c salutem dicit.
passages.english: To the lord RUFINUS, a most beloved brother in Christ and deservedly venerable, PROSPER [sends] eternal greeting.
passages.notes: The stray letters 'b' and 'c' are footnote marks from the printed edition and have been omitted. 'Salutem dicit' is the standard letter-opening formula; 'aeternam salutem' could also be rendered 'eternal salvation', a play the formula may intend.
